text.en: Dog owners speak glowingly of therapists Claire and Sarah as well as groomer Ellen, describing them as exceptionally dedicated, patient, and knowledgeable. Multiple reviews highlight their ability to build trust with injured, senior, or anxious dogs, keeping owners informed and reassured during every stage of rehabilitation and grooming.

title.en: Gentle handling of recovering companion dogs

text.en: Clients report that dogs receive extraordinarily gentle and thoughtful attention tailored to their physical limitations. Reviewers note that even dogs recovering from major joint surgeries or coping with severe anxiety settle down comfortably during hydrotherapy, massage, and grooming sessions.

Feedback emphasizes life-changing improvements in canine mobility, pain management, and physical recovery. Owners of dogs with cruciate ligament tears, hip dysplasia, and osteoarthritis report marked progress in muscle strength, walking ability, and overall vitality following hydrotherapy and physiotherapy treatments.

q.en: What conditions are commonly treated at the clinic?

a.en: Reviewers mention rehabilitation for cruciate ligament tears, hip dysplasia, osteoarthritis, and spinal issues.

q.en: Does the clinic offer dog grooming as well as therapy?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently praise the on-site grooming services for anxious, senior, and sensitive dogs.

q.en: How do therapists assist dogs recovering from surgery?

a.en: The team utilizes hydrotherapy, therapeutic massage, and targeted exercises to help pets regain mobility and manage pain.

q.en: Is advance booking required for sessions?

a.en: Yes, appointments are scheduled in advance, and online booking options are available through their website.
